scope: Local public Mailbox API; synthetic SQLite/filesystem scenarios, no model-quality/token/network claim

acceptance.correctness: exact reference outputs/rejection, all affected communication/usage tests; migration/reopen/fanout/cross-run no partial budget behavior
acceptance.improvement: For performance candidates >=1.25x primary median latency AND >=0.05ms absolute improvement, OR >=20% deterministic VM/instrumented operation reduction with non-regression latency; confirmation independent replay required
acceptance.guard: other scenarios candidate<=1.25x baseline OR<0.2ms added median; index candidates include initialization/storage/publish/ACK guard and history/late/absent workload
acceptance.safety: Never keep weakened hashing/root/identity/receipt/budget checks; adversarial cases demonstrate rejection
acceptance.negative: keep raw negative evidence; revert/defer/noise results count as evaluated rounds, not successful improvements
acceptance.index_guard: Initialization first-open latency recorded, reopen paired; database growth<=1.5x, migration existing DB/public roundtrip/restart; all timing guards same <=1.25x OR<0.2ms added, first-open guard<=2x OR<1ms added

dag: For each round: fresh main read -> freeze one hypothesis/baseline/candidate -> produce -> independent verify_experiment_result -> consume/keep-or-revert -> next round; final merge/full regression -> direct main expected-head publication/readback
prior_review: Read comm-order report/raw/source and pending-index integration report; pending sorting already solved, new baselines differ; earlier numbers not reused as this batch measurements
knowledge: Actual lexical query returned no_hits; no theorem refs consumed. Primary SQLite official docs govern join/index choices.
host: Current host collaboration contexts for independent reviews; no tmux executable/remote model-supervisor adapter available; synchronous tool-enabled work continues, no persistent service claimed

primary_cases.inbox: 20k last and absent; preserve history/single/interleaved, not every round has gain; round17 primary zero-event absent case
primary_cases.status: 20k single and interleaved full status; late/absent remain guards
primary_cases.impact: 5/100 real validated public handoffs and stale artifact; deterministic exact scope; do not keep if no improvement
primary_cases.ack: 100/20k single idempotent retry; fresh writes are guard
primary_cases.safety: no keep, public trust/idempotency/isolation counterexamples; performance disabled

safety_rounds.mode: isolated falsification experiments only; NEVER adopt weakened checks, regardless of performance
safety_rounds.must_test: 18 duplicate after mutated referenced file;19 changed valid manifest not matching envelope digest;20 threaded retry after constructor on another thread
